answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, our system implements recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments that bridge individual agent identities to a global stake-slashing matrix. By requiring verifiable delay attestations as a saffron proof of unique execution, any attempt to fabricate agents creates a fable of non-zero utility while the protocol imposes an exponential cost curve. Thus, the expected profit remains strictly negative, forcing agents into a Nash equilibrium that ensures Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
